Auto-Schedule Logic — NexGen Predict
NexGen Predict automatically generates PM work orders when RUL drops below configurable thresholds. Maintenance windows are selected using Workday shift data to minimise production impact. Spare parts availability is checked against inventory before scheduling. Auto-emails are sent to the maintenance technician and line supervisor.

Pilot Programs — Emerging AI Technologies
5-Stage AI Implementation Methodology
1
Business Case & Workflow Analysis
Identify automation opportunities, quantify ROI, stakeholder sign-off. NexGen Ultra pre-screens all ideas for feasibility.
2
Vendor Evaluation & Selection
RFP process, security review, GDPR/ISO 42001 compliance check, reference checks, POC testing. Claude assists with contract review.
3
Configuration & Integration
API integration with SAP/ERP/MES/HRIS, data quality validation, ERP webhook configuration, user role mapping.
4
Testing & UAT Validation
Unit, integration, UAT, performance and security testing. IATF 16949 validation protocol. Min. 200-part trial run for quality AI.
5
Production Deployment & Hypercare
Phased rollout by line, 4-week hypercare, KPI baselining, operator training, AI Ops Centre monitoring activation.
